blogs.title: When the Lungs Lie: Decoding Amylase-Rich 'Bloody' Effusions
blogs.description: This post analyzes the classic pitfall of mistaking a pancreatopleural fistula (PPF) for primary pulmonary pathology. It focuses on the critical importance of checking pleural fluid chemistry—specifically distinguishing between amylase sources—in any recurrent, bloody pleural effusion that defies conventional explanations. We explore why 'dark red' fluid combined with high amylase/lipase ratios demands immediate investigation beyond TB and pneumonia protocols.

blogs.title: Blind Spots in Pediatrics: Trauma History vs. School Bullying
blogs.description: Reflecting on the specific challenges of pediatric history-taking when social factors interfere with disclosure. This narrative-driven piece discusses how a hidden history of blunt abdominal trauma (a bicycle accident) was initially obscured because the child feared retribution/bullying. It highlights the necessity of repetitive, safe-history taking and considering mechanical triggers even years or weeks after an event seems resolved clinically.
